description: `instanceof` against an ordinary class runs no user code and passes; against a class declaring `Symbol.hasInstance` it takes that member's color.

diagnostics.message: Checking `value instanceof Custom` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the method `[Symbol.hasInstance]`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the method `[Symbol.hasInstance]` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
